newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH EXPORT CREDIT 9-MTH PROFIT FALLS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH EXPORT CREDIT 9-MTH PROFIT FALLS.

text.p: HELSINKI, Dec 2 (Reutere) - Financing company Finnish Export Credit (Vientiluotto) said in a statement on Monday its January-September operating profit before taxes fell to 218 million markka from 297 million in the year-ago period.
Vientiluotto said the fall in profit was largely due to exceptionally big income on securities trading in January-September last year.
Despite the fall, the profit was above budget, it said.
"The estimate for the 1996 operating profit before tax has been raised from the 230 million markka projected in June to 290 million markka," Vientiluotto said.
